## Load gene expression data

From GEO https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE158420
GSE158420_counts.txt.gz

Data was cleaned according to another script `GSE158420_geneexpression_prep.Rmd`

```{r,loaddat}

x <- readRDS("GSE158420_counts_fixed.rds")

x[1:6,1:5]

```

## Get reactome gene sets

```{r,reactome}

gmt_import <- function(gmtfile) {
    genesetLines <- strsplit(readLines(gmtfile), "\t")
    genesets <- lapply(genesetLines, utils::tail, -2)
    names(genesets) <- unlist(lapply(genesetLines, head, 1))
    attributes(genesets)$originfile <- gmtfile
    genesets <- genesets[lapply(genesets,length)>0]
    if( any(duplicated(names(genesets))) ) {
        warning("Duplicated gene sets names detected")
    }
    genesets
}

gs <- gmt_import("ReactomePathways_2026-10-23.gmt")

```

## Samplesheet set up

```{r,samplesheet}

ss <- as.data.frame(colnames(x))
rownames(ss) <- ss[,1]
ss$patient <- factor(gsub("T","",gsub("N","",gsub("X","",ss[,1]))))
ss$tumor <- factor(grepl("T",ss[,1]))
ss[,1]=NULL
head(ss)

```

## Downsample

```{r,downsample_gsva_tc}

gsva_tc <- function(NPAT,i,gs) {
  set.seed(i*100)
  PATS <- sample(unique(ss$patient),NPAT,replace=FALSE)
  ssd <- ss[which(ss$patient %in% PATS),]
  ssd$patient <- as.factor(as.character(ssd$patient))
  xd <- x[,colnames(x) %in% rownames(ssd)]
  xdf <- xd[which(rowMeans(xd) > 5),]
  y <- DGEList(counts = xdf)
  y <- normLibSizes(y) #edgeR
  expr <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
  param <- gsvaParam( expr = expr, geneSets = gs, kcdf = "Gaussian", minSize = 5, maxSize = 5000)
  scores <- gsva(param)
  design <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor, data = ssd)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(scores, design)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)
  results <- limma::topTable( fit, coef = "tumorTRUE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  confects <- limma_confects(fit, coef="tumorTRUE", fdr=0.05)
  m0 <- merge(results,confects$table,by.x=0,by.y="name")
  return(m0)
}

run_fgsea <- function(NPAT,i,gs) {
  set.seed(i*100)
  PATS <- sample(unique(ss$patient),NPAT,replace=FALSE)
  ssd <- ss[which(ss$patient %in% PATS),]
  ssd$patient <- as.factor(as.character(ssd$patient))
  xd <- x[,colnames(x) %in% rownames(ssd)]
  xdf <- xd[which(rowMeans(xd) > 5),]
  y <- DGEList(counts = xdf)
  y <- normLibSizes(y)
  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + patient + tumor, data = ssd)
  v <- voom(y, design)
  fit <- lmFit(v, design)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
  results <- topTable(fit2, coef = "tumorTRUE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  stats <- results$t
  names(stats) <- rownames(results)
  fres <- fgsea(pathways=gs, stats=stats, minSize=5, nproc=1 )
  fres <- as.data.frame(fres)
  fres <- fres[order(fres$pval),]
  head(fres)
  return(fres)
}

ora <- function(NPAT,i,gs) {
  set.seed(i*100)
  PATS <- sample(unique(ss$patient),NPAT,replace=FALSE)
  ssd <- ss[which(ss$patient %in% PATS),]
  ssd$patient <- as.factor(as.character(ssd$patient))
  xd <- x[,colnames(x) %in% rownames(ssd)]
  xdf <- xd[which(rowMeans(xd) > 5),]
  y <- DGEList(counts = xdf)
  y <- normLibSizes(y)
  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + patient + tumor, data = ssd)
  v <- voom(y, design)
  fit <- lmFit(v, design)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
  results <- topTable(fit2, coef = "tumorTRUE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  up <- unique(rownames(head(subset(results, logFC>0),750)))
  dn <- unique(rownames(head(subset(results, logFC<0),750)))
  bg <- unique(rownames(results))
  ores_up <- fora(pathways=gs,genes=up,universe=bg,minSize=5)
  ores_dn <- fora(pathways=gs,genes=dn,universe=bg,minSize=5)
  ores_dn$foldEnrichment <- ores_dn$foldEnrichment * -1
  ores <- rbind(ores_dn,ores_up)
  return(ores)
}

```

## General test

```{r,overlaps}

ores <- ora(NPAT=37,i,gs)
fres <- run_fgsea(NPAT=37,i,gs)
gres <- gsva_tc(NPAT=37,i,gs)

o_up <- subset(ores,padj < 0.05 & foldEnrichment > 0)$pathway
o_dn <- subset(ores,padj < 0.05 & foldEnrichment < 0)$pathway

f_up <- subset(fres,padj < 0.05 & NES > 0)$pathway
f_dn <- subset(fres,padj < 0.05 & NES < 0)$pathway

g_up <- subset(gres,adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 )$Row.names
g_dn <- subset(gres,adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 )$Row.names

v1 <- list("ORA up"=o_up, "FCS up"=f_up, "GSVA up"=g_up)
plot(euler(v1),quantities = TRUE)

v1 <- list("ORA dn"=o_dn, "FCS dn"=f_dn, "GSVA dn"=g_dn)
plot(euler(v1),quantities = TRUE)

```

## Now look at different sample sizes

```{r,sample_sizes}

TESTRANGE <- c(2,3,4,5,6,8,10,12,16,22,30)
NREPS=10

myres <- lapply( TESTRANGE, function(n) {

  gg <- unlist(mclapply(1:NREPS, function(i) {
    gr <- gsva_tc(NPAT=n,i,gs)
    nrow(subset(gr,adj.P.Val<0.05))
  }, mc.cores=10))

  ff <- unlist(mclapply(1:NREPS, function(i) {
    fr <- run_fgsea(NPAT=n,i,gs)
    nrow(subset(fr,padj<0.05))
  }, mc.cores=10))

  oo <- unlist(mclapply(1:NREPS, function(i) {
    or <- ora(NPAT=n,i,gs)
    nrow(subset(or,padj<0.05))
  }, mc.cores=10))

  return(list("gg"=gg,"ff"=ff,"oo"=oo))
})
```

## Split and run

Here we downsample the samples and then compare the results to the full 37 patients.

```{r,split_n_run_functions}

gsva2 <- function(NPAT=5,i,gs) {

  # full 37
  m1up <- subset(gres,adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 )$Row.names
  m1up <- paste(m1up,"up")
  m1dn <- subset(gres,adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 )$Row.names
  m1dn <- paste(m1up,"dn")
  m1updn <- c(m1up,m1dn)

  set.seed(i*100)
  PATS <- sample( ss$patient, NPAT, replace=FALSE )
  ssd2 <- ss[which(ss$patient %in% PATS),]
  ssd2$patient <- as.factor(as.character(ssd2$patient))
  xd2 <- x[,colnames(x) %in% rownames(ssd2)]
  xdf2 <- xd2[which(rowMeans(xd2) > 5),]
  y2 <- DGEList(counts = xdf2)
  y2 <- normLibSizes(y2) #edgeR
  expr2 <- cpm(y2, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
  param2 <- gsvaParam( expr = expr2, geneSets = gs, kcdf = "Gaussian", minSize = 5, maxSize = 5000)
  scores2 <- gsva(param2)
  design2 <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor, data = ssd2)
  fit2 <- limma::lmFit(scores2, design2)
  fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit2)
  results2 <- limma::topTable( fit2, coef = "tumorTRUE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  confects2 <- limma_confects(fit2, coef="tumorTRUE", fdr=0.05)
  m2 <- merge(results2,confects2$table,by.x=0,by.y="name")
  m2up <- subset(m2,adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 )$Row.names
  m2up <- paste(m2up,"up")
  m2dn <- subset(m2,adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 )$Row.names
  m2dn <- paste(m2up,"dn")
  m2updn <- c(m2up,m2dn)

  m1_n <- length(m1updn)
  m2_n <- length(m2updn)
  ix_n <- length( intersect( m1updn , m2updn ))
  fn_n <- length(setdiff(m1updn,m2updn))
  fp_n <- length(setdiff(m2updn,m1updn))
  un_n <- length( union( m1updn , m2updn ))
  jac <- ix_n / un_n
  rec <- ix_n / m1_n
  prec <- ix_n / ( ix_n + fp_n )
  return(c("m1_n"=m1_n, "m2_n"=m2_n, "ix_n"=ix_n, "fn_n"=fn_n, "fp_n"=fp_n, "un_n"=un_n, "jac"=jac, "rec"=rec, "prec"=prec))

}

#gdf <- do.call(rbind,gres)
#colMeans(gdf)

fgsea2 <- function(NPAT1=18,NPAT2=5,i,gs) {

  set.seed(i*100)
  PATS1 <- sample(unique(ss$patient),NPAT1,replace=FALSE)
  ssd1 <- ss[which(ss$patient %in% PATS1),]
  ssd1$patient <- as.factor(as.character(ssd1$patient))
  xd1 <- x[,colnames(x) %in% rownames(ssd1)]
  xdf1 <- xd1[which(rowMeans(xd1) > 5),]

  y1 <- DGEList(counts = xdf1)
  y1 <- normLibSizes(y1)
  design1 <- model.matrix(~ 0 + patient + tumor, data = ssd1)
  v1 <- voom(y1, design1)
  fit1 <- lmFit(v1, design1)
  fit1 <- eBayes(fit1)
  results1 <- topTable(fit1, coef = "tumorTRUE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  stats1 <- results1$t
  names(stats1) <- rownames(results1)
  fres1 <- fgsea(pathways=gs, stats=stats1, minSize=5 ,nproc=1 )
  fres1 <- as.data.frame(fres1)
  fres1 <- fres1[order(fres1$pval),]

  f1up <- subset(fres1[order(-fres1$NES),],padj<0.05)$pathway
  f1up <- paste(f1up,"up")
  f1dn <- subset(fres1[order(fres1$NES),],padj<0.05)$pathway
  f1dn <- paste(f1dn,"dn")
  f1updn <- c(f1up,f1dn)

  set.seed(i*100)
  PATS2 <- sample( setdiff(unique(ss$patient) , PATS1), NPAT2, replace=FALSE )
  ssd2 <- ss[which(ss$patient %in% PATS2),]
  ssd2$patient <- as.factor(as.character(ssd2$patient))
  xd2 <- x[,colnames(x) %in% rownames(ssd2)]
  xdf2 <- xd2[which(rowMeans(xd2) > 5),]

  y2 <- DGEList(counts = xdf2)
  y2 <- normLibSizes(y2)
  design2 <- model.matrix(~ 0 + patient + tumor, data = ssd2)
  v2 <- voom(y2, design2)
  fit2 <- lmFit(v2, design2)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
  results2 <- topTable(fit2, coef = "tumorTRUE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  stats2 <- results2$t
  names(stats2) <- rownames(results2)
  fres2 <- fgsea(pathways=gs, stats=stats2, minSize=5 , nproc=1 )
  fres2 <- as.data.frame(fres2)
  fres2 <- fres2[order(fres2$pval),]

  f2up <- subset(fres2[order(-fres2$NES),],padj<0.05)$pathway
  f2up <- paste(f2up,"up")
  f2dn <- subset(fres2[order(fres2$NES),],padj<0.05)$pathway
  f2dn <- paste(f2dn,"dn")
  f2updn <- c(f2up,f2dn)

  f1_n <- length(f1updn)
  f2_n <- length(f2updn)
  ix_n <- length( intersect( f1updn , f2updn ))
  un_n <- length( union( f1updn , f2updn ))
  fn_n <- length(setdiff(f1updn,f2updn))
  fp_n <- length(setdiff(f2updn,f1updn))
  jac <- ix_n / un_n
  rec <- ix_n / f1_n
  prec <- ix_n / ( ix_n + fp_n )
  return(c("f1_n"=f1_n, "f2_n"=f2_n, "ix_n"=ix_n, "fn_n"=fn_n, "fp_n"=fp_n, "un_n"=un_n, "jac"=jac, "rec"=rec, "prec"=prec))

}

ora2 <- function(NPAT1=18,NPAT2=5,i,gs) {

  set.seed(i*100)
  PATS1 <- sample(unique(ss$patient),NPAT1,replace=FALSE)
  ssd1 <- ss[which(ss$patient %in% PATS1),]
  ssd1$patient <- as.factor(as.character(ssd1$patient))
  xd1 <- x[,colnames(x) %in% rownames(ssd1)]
  xdf1 <- xd1[which(rowMeans(xd1) > 5),]

  y1 <- DGEList(counts = xdf1)
  y1 <- normLibSizes(y1)
  design1 <- model.matrix(~ 0 + patient + tumor, data = ssd1)
  v1 <- voom(y1, design1)
  fit1 <- lmFit(v1, design1)
  fit1 <- eBayes(fit1)
  results1 <- topTable(fit1, coef = "tumorTRUE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  up <- rownames(subset(results1,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC > 0))
  dn <- rownames(subset(results1,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC < 0))
  bg <- unique(rownames(results1))
  ores_up <- fora(pathways=gs,genes=up,universe=bg,minSize=5)
  ores_dn <- fora(pathways=gs,genes=dn,universe=bg,minSize=5)
  o1up <- subset(ores_up,padj<0.05)$pathway
  o1dn <- subset(ores_dn,padj<0.05)$pathway
  o1up <- paste(o1up,"up")
  o1dn <- paste(o1dn,"dn")
  o1updn <- c(o1up,o1dn)

  set.seed(i*100)
  PATS2 <- sample( setdiff(unique(ss$patient) , PATS1), NPAT2, replace=FALSE )
  ssd2 <- ss[which(ss$patient %in% PATS2),]
  ssd2$patient <- as.factor(as.character(ssd2$patient))
  xd2 <- x[,colnames(x) %in% rownames(ssd2)]
  xdf2 <- xd2[which(rowMeans(xd2) > 5),]

  y2 <- DGEList(counts = xdf2)
  y2 <- normLibSizes(y2)
  design2 <- model.matrix(~ 0 + patient + tumor, data = ssd2)
  v2 <- voom(y2, design2)
  fit2 <- lmFit(v2, design2)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
  results2 <- topTable(fit2, coef = "tumorTRUE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  up <- rownames(subset(results2,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC > 0))
  dn <- rownames(subset(results2,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC < 0))
  bg <- unique(rownames(results2))
  ores_up <- fora(pathways=gs,genes=up,universe=bg,minSize=5)
  ores_dn <- fora(pathways=gs,genes=dn,universe=bg,minSize=5)
  o2up <- subset(ores_up,padj<0.05)$pathway
  o2dn <- subset(ores_dn,padj<0.05)$pathway
  o2up <- paste(o2up,"up")
  o2dn <- paste(o2dn,"dn")
  o2updn <- c(o2up,o2dn)

  o1_n <- length(o1updn)
  o2_n <- length(o2updn)
  ix_n <- length( intersect( o1updn , o2updn ))
  un_n <- length( union( o1updn , o2updn ))
  fn_n <- length(setdiff( o1updn, o2updn))
  fp_n <- length(setdiff( o2updn, o1updn))
  jac <- ix_n / un_n
  rec <- ix_n / o1_n
  prec <- ix_n / ( ix_n + fp_n )
  return(c("o1_n"=o1_n, "o2_n"=o2_n, "ix_n"=ix_n, "fn_n"=fn_n, "fp_n"=fp_n, "un_n"=un_n, "jac"=jac, "rec"=rec, "prec"=prec))

}
```

Lets run some analysis.

```{r,split_n_run}

REPS=10
TESTRANGE <- seq(2,16,2)

res <- lapply( TESTRANGE , function(n) {
  gres <- mclapply(1:REPS,function(i) { gsva2(NPAT1=18, NPAT2=n, i=i, gs) } , mc.cores=10)
  gdf <- do.call(rbind,gres)
  fres <- mclapply(1:REPS,function(i) { fgsea2(NPAT1=18, NPAT2=n, i=i, gs) } , mc.cores=10)
  fdf <- do.call(rbind,fres)
  ores <- mclapply(1:REPS,function(i) { ora2(NPAT1=18, NPAT2=n, i=i, gs) } , mc.cores=10)
  odf <- do.call(rbind,ores)
  res <- list("g"=gdf,"f"=fdf,"o"=odf)
  return(res)
})

g_prec <- lapply(res, function(x) { x$g[,"prec"] } )
names(g_prec) <- TESTRANGE
g_rec <- lapply(res, function(x) { x$g[,"rec"] } )
names(g_rec) <- TESTRANGE

f_prec <- lapply(res, function(x) { x$f[,"prec"] } )
names(f_prec) <- TESTRANGE
f_rec <- lapply(res, function(x) { x$f[,"rec"] } )
names(f_rec) <- TESTRANGE

o_prec <- lapply(res, function(x) { x$o[,"prec"] } )
names(o_prec) <- TESTRANGE
o_rec <- lapply(res, function(x) { x$o[,"rec"] } )
names(o_rec) <- TESTRANGE
```

```{r,linegraph}
plot( TESTRANGE, lapply(g_prec,mean), type="b" , col="darkgreen", xlab="n reps",ylab="precision", ylim=c(0,1))
lapply(1:length(g_prec), function(i) {
  y0 <- summary(g_prec[[i]])[2]
  y1 <- summary(g_prec[[i]])[5]
  arrows(x0=TESTRANGE[i],x1=TESTRANGE[i],y0=y0,y1=y1, length=0.1, angle=90, code=3 ,col="darkgreen")
} )

points( TESTRANGE, lapply(f_prec,mean), type="b" , col="darkorange")
lapply(1:length(f_prec), function(i) {
  y0 <- summary(f_prec[[i]])[2]
  y1 <- summary(f_prec[[i]])[5]
  arrows(x0=TESTRANGE[i]+0.2,x1=TESTRANGE[i]+0.2,y0=y0,y1=y1, length=0.1, angle=90, code=3 ,col="darkorange")
} )


points( TESTRANGE, lapply(o_prec,mean), type="b" , col="magenta")
lapply(1:length(o_prec), function(i) {
  y0 <- summary(o_prec[[i]])[2]
  y1 <- summary(o_prec[[i]])[5]
  arrows(x0=TESTRANGE[i]-0.2,x1=TESTRANGE[i]-0.2,y0=y0,y1=y1, length=0.1, angle=90, code=3 ,col="magenta")
} )

par(mfrow=c(1,1))

signif(sapply(g_rec,mean),3)
signif(sapply(f_rec,mean),3)
signif(sapply(o_rec,mean),3)

signif(sapply(g_prec,mean),3)
signif(sapply(f_prec,mean),3)
signif(sapply(o_prec,mean),3)



mean(sapply(g_rec,mean))
mean(sapply(f_rec,mean))
mean(sapply(o_rec,mean))

mean(sapply(g_prec,mean))
mean(sapply(f_prec,mean))
mean(sapply(o_prec,mean))
```
